item.title: Everything NEW in Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5 (Edgerunners 2)
item.description:
Cyberpunk 2077 received yet another final update with the release of Edgerunners 2! Update 2.5 for Cyberpunk 2077 has a few exciting features to go over. Below, we'll share which details you'll be most interested in when you update Cyberpunk 2077 . You can also find complete guides related to the new content right here so you can jump back into Night City.

Cyberpunk 2077 Update 2.5 is Live Now

Ahead of the surprising launch of Update 2.5 for Cyberpunk 2077, which includes new Edgerunners 2 content, CDPR reveals the full patch notes.

By Derek Nichols

All Features Added in Cyberpunk 2077 Edgerunners Update 2.5

New Feature

Type

Description

Clampdown

Side Quest

Help King and his team of Edgerunners free one of their own with a prison break.

Welcome to Paradise

Side Quest

Solve a mystery through the Night City Tours involving Night City's founder, Richard Night.

Minor Arcana

Collectibles

Find 12 Minor Arcana Tarot Cards across Night City for a unique t-shirt.

HKLGN 102.0FM

Radio Station

In-game radio station that plays music from the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners series.

New Outfits

Clothing

New clothing arrives with the Maxiwear, Jinguji, NetWatch, IconAmerica, and King sets.

Hairstyles

Cosmetics

V now has more NPC hairstyles for fem and masc body types.

Glamdocs

Cyberware Customization

Visit Glamdocs in Night City to customize the visuals of your Arms Cyberware.

Dual Wielding

Perk

The Double Trouble Perk in the Cool Tree allows you to dual-wield Pistols and Revolvers.

Poses

Photo Mode

New poses and frames for Photo Mode.

Cross-Platform Mods

Mod Support

Allows the use of mod.io mods on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

FOV Sliders

Console Support

Adds an FOV Slider for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

Grouped Save Files

Game Support

Save Files are grouped by separate playthroughs, marked by your life path.

item.title: Steam Officially Makes 1 Open-World Game 100% Free Until October 26
item.description:
While Steam 's Free Weekend Promotion typically focuses on a handful of games, this weekend is a little different, as Steam users will only have 1 game to claim this weekend. Typically costing $9.99, the Steam Free Weekend game is an underrated gem known as DeadPoly .

For anyone new, Steam typically hosts two different free game promotions (aside from developers making their games free to play): the Free Weekend Promotion and the Free-to-Keep Promotion. The latter means games are permanently free as long as someone claims it by an expiration date, while the former means games are permanently free to play until an expiration date. In this case, Steam users have until October 26 at 10 am PT/1 pm ET to play DeadPoly at no cost.

Xbox Officially Makes 6 Games 100% Free Until ~October 25, Includes 2 Monster Hunter Games

Xbox makes six different games free to play until roughly October 25, including two Capcom Monster Hunter games.

By Joshua Duckworth

Steam Free Weekend (October 22-October 26)

Steam has made DeadPoly free to play until October 26 at 10 am PT/1 pm ET . For those unaware, DeadPoly is an open-world zombie survival-crafting game that combines third-person shooting, scavenging, crafting, and base building with a distinctive low-poly art style. Developed by TFL Games, the game challenges players to survive a zombie apocalypse by gathering resources, collecting weapons, fortifying shelters, and managing hunger and thirst. Players can explore alone or with friends through online co-op, while additional features include farming, fishing, hunting, customizable firearms, and drivable vehicles. The link below will take players directly to Steam; they do not have to "buy" this game.

DeadPoly has earned Mostly Positive reviews on Steam, with 78% of its 4,114 English-language reviews recommending the game. Recent reception has also been Mostly Positive, with 70% positive feedback across 60 reviews in the past 30 days. The open-world survival-crafting gameplay loop, base-building, and low-poly simplicity are central to its appeal, although certain aspects remain unfinished. The overall reception is encouraging for an indie zombie survival game developed by a single person, particularly as DeadPoly approaches its planned full release in 2027.

What Other Games Are Free on Steam Right Now?

DeadPoly isn't for everyone, despite the solid and surprising reviews. Even the biggest fans of the best open-world survival-crafting games may be put off by one of its design choices, but there's plenty of content out there to consider besides DeadPoly as well.

There's not much else from Steam officially, although Steam's Free-to-Keep Promotion is currently giving away free Squad DLC, as well as additional content for Popcorn & Premieren . Meanwhile, several games have also moved permanently to free-to-play:

  • Free-to-Keep Squad DLC (Available Until October 25)
  • Free-to-Keep Popcorn & Premieren (Available Until October 29)
  • Permanently Free-to-Play: 2026 Dark Fantasy RPG Heavy Wake
  • Permanently Free-to-Play: 2026 Co-Op Shooter Shenaniguns
  • Permanently Free-to-Play: 22-games-in-1 Cartomancy Anthology

It's possible Steam adds more to the Free Weekend line-up later this weekend. Stay tuned if none of the above works.

item.title: 5 FPS Characters Stronger Than Halo's Master Chief, Ranked
item.description:
Halo 's Master Chief is hands-down one of the most recognizable characters in FPS history, at least in my book. If you don’t know who he is, congratulations, you’ve been living under a rock. Master Chief is a genetically enhanced super soldier who has survived battles against some pretty terrifying enemies, to say the least.

His strength is more than impressive, and his armor has no equal when it comes to resisting attacks. However, just because he’s powerful doesn’t mean that he is the strongest character in the entire FPS genre . In fact, there are a few FPS protagonists who could potentially take Master Chief down in a fight , and some of them wouldn’t even have to break a sweat.

5 Destiny 2 - The Guardian

Even Death Can’t Stop Him

If you're a fan of science fiction, you will definitely love Destiny 2 , especially once you get to see the sheer power of the Guardian who's ready to face any alien threat. He is a warrior empowered by the Traveler, a mysterious cosmic entity associated with the Light. Unlike Master Chief, he possesses supernatural abilities that exceed the power of any conventional military equipment.

Find all 10 pairs

Results

0
—
More Games

Depending on their class and subclass, Guardians are able to wield not one, but several supernatural powers that could give them an advantage over Master Chief. To give an example, Stasis could freeze him in place, and Strand could suspend him midair, while Solar and Arc could allow the Guardian to unleash devastating elemental attacks that his energy shield wouldn't be able to withstand. Sure, Master Chief is extremely durable, but his physical enhancement skills would not be very useful against an enemy that has so many ways of restricting his movement and freezing his attacks.

However, perhaps the biggest advantage the Guardians have is the so-called Ghost that can resurrect them if they die, which is a significant boost no matter what enemy you’re fighting. Last, but not least, the Guardian has a history of defeating some tough enemies, including the powerful Hive gods and the Witness. The latter is a cosmic antagonist threatening to end existence itself, so if beating that isn’t a good track record, I’m not sure what is.

4 DOOM Eternal - Doom Slayer

The Warrior Who Defeats Hell's Worst Monsters

As we all probably know, the Doom Slayer is more than an ordinary soldier; he’s a powerful warrior fighting to stop demonic forces from conquering Earth. Talk about a stressful job. He possesses superhuman strength, speed, and endurance, which is a very big part of why he made this list, obviously. However, his arsenal is no less impressive, as it includes some powerful close-range weapons such as the Super Shotgun and Crucible Blade that can kill nearby enemies almost instantly. The Doom Slayer's greatest achievement, though, lies elsewhere. In DOOM Eternal , he defeats the Icon of Sin.

Doom Eternal: History of the Doom Slayer

In Doom Eternal, the marine once known as Doomguy has become the Doom Slayer, a mythological warrior regarded with almost religious reverence.

By Hank Whitson

If you don’t know what that is, you’re lucky you haven’t met it. It’s basically a gigantic demon capable of destroying entire worlds. Master Chief might be an exceptional Spartan, but the Doom Slayer has demonstrated extreme physical resilience and capabilities far beyond what even an enhanced soldier can accomplish. Besides, we shouldn’t forget the Doom Slayer’s ability to replenish his health and armor by killing his enemies. Yeah, Master Chief is done for.

DOOM Eternal

3 Metroid Prime - Samus Aran

Advanced Chozo Technology Gives Her An Edge

Samus Aran is an intergalactic bounty hunter. She investigates alien threats, and in Metroid Prime specifically, she undertakes the task of exploring the planet Tallon 4. Samus possesses Chozo DNA and wears an extraordinarily advanced Power Suit that enhances her abilities. By using her Arm Cannon, she can fire energy beams and missiles, which gives her plenty of ways to attack Master Chief from a distance.

Halo: Ranking The 22 Strongest Spartans (That Aren't Master Chief)

From members of Blue Team to Noble 6, there are plenty of Spartan-IIIs and IVs that can compare to Master Chief.

By Charles Burgar

Moreover, her Ice Beam can freeze enemies, which means they remain completely defenseless against her. The Wave Beam, on the other hand, fires electrical energy that could put pressure on Master Chief's shields. I guess the most impressive aspect for me personally is the fact that, thanks to the Morph Ball, she can squeeze into any space and evade incoming attacks. This is all before I even mention the Screw Attack that she uses in later Metroid Prime games.

No matter how impressive Master Chief’s armor and reflexes are, there’s simply no way for him to compete with Samus Aran’s weapons and superhuman mobility. Even if he manages to withstand her energy attacks, it would still be impossible to keep up with her constantly charging shots. I almost feel bad for the Spartan.

Metroid Prime

2 Dishonored - Corvo Attano

A Force To Be Reckoned With

Corvo Attano is the star of Dishonored . This first-person action game is one of the best examples of stealth combined with supernatural powers. Master Chief might have access to advanced military technology and enhanced physical strength on his side, but the supernatural abilities that Corvo Attano uses would give him a significant advantage.

I know what you’re thinking. This list is all about supernatural powers versus a guy who is just genetically enhanced. Not exactly a fair comparison, I know, but Master Chief is hardly an ordinary human himself, and he could hold his own against Corvo Attano, at least for a while. However, even though his shields could help him at the beginning, I think once Corvo starts using Blink to teleport around the battlefield, Master Chief will simply not be able to follow and anticipate his movements.

However, even if Master Chief managed by some miracle to predict Corvo's movements, Corvo could just use Bend Time to slow down or stop time, which would allow him to approach Master Chief in any way he wants. Sure, this doesn’t mean he’ll be able to penetrate his opponent’s armor, but it would definitely allow him to target some vulnerable areas and, given enough time, eventually finish him off.

Dishonored

1 Serious Sam - Sam Serious Stone

A One-Man Army With Serious Firepower

Serious Sam was probably the first FPS franchise I ever got into, and it still remains one of my absolute favorite titles. In any case, it’s hard not to be impressed by Sam’s ability to defeat enormous hordes of extraterrestrial enemies. Unlike the other characters I’ve included on this list, Sam doesn’t really rely on supernatural powers, which could result in a more even fight between him and Master Chief.

Every Serious Sam Game, Ranked

Double your gun, double your fun! With how many Serious Sam games are now in the series, it's time to see how they all stack up against each other.

By Borealis Capps

It’s important to mention that Sam’s arsenal of weapons is just insanely impressive. Apart from all his standard weapons, Sam also carries miniguns, rocket launchers, laser weapons, and a giant cannon that fires iron projectiles. If I were Master Chief, I’d make a run for it. Despite the fact that Master Chief is nowhere near defenseless, Sam could potentially overwhelm his shields with sustained fire from his heavier weapons. In a world where Sam defeats multiple enormous monsters simultaneously, Master Chief just doesn’t stand a chance.

item.title: Final Fantasy Resonance: All Main Chapters and Subquests
item.description:
Final Fantasy Resonance splits its quests into two categories: Main and Sub. The main quests will progress the overall story and unlock new regions to explore. The sub quests, or side quests, are still worth doing because there are some wonderful rewards that will help you on your journey. This guide will list every chapter and sub quest in Final Fantasy Resonance , along with the rewards for completing every sub quest.

Final Fantasy Resonance: All Tablet Shard Locations and Oblivion Palace Rewards

Need to know where to find all the tablet shards in Final Fantasy Resonance? This guide shows you all the locations and rewards.

By Steve Booker

All Chapters in Final Fantasy Resonance

The main quest of Final Fantasy Resonance is broken up into 8 different Chapters:

  • Chapter 1 - Tailing the Truth
  • Chapter 2 - Eternal Blue
  • Chapter 3 - Wardens of the Squapolis
  • Chapter 4 - Banner Oath
  • Chapter 5 - Scars of Time
  • Chapter 6 - Tranquility
  • Chapter 7 Reconing
  • Chapter 8 - Beyond Hope

Each of these chapters has their own set of sub quests that become available at various points during the chapter.

item.title: Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake's Most Underrated Upgrade Is Navi's New Role
item.description:
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time 's Navi has long been the source of some of gaming's oldest memes, primarily due to her incessant need to hold Link's hand throughout his journey to save Hyrule. I say that somewhat sarcastically, because I personally never had a problem with how frequently Navi interrupted the experience. Granted, when I was a kid, I really didn't have much of a problem at all with game design in general because I was ignorant of it and just having fun—something gamers have seemingly lost over the years. Nevertheless, the upcoming Ocarina of Time remake has made some massive changes to Navi, no doubt due to the criticism she has been receiving for nearly three decades, and it's one of those upgrades that I think has been overlooked on account of some of the remake's other major improvements.

To be fair, the Ocarina of Time remake's manual jump button and free camera are two of its biggest quality-of-life upgrades, especially for veterans like myself, so forgive us if we're not immediately awestruck by the changes to Navi's role. Still, I think the iconic fairy's new mechanics are worth talking about, considering she has received the brunt of the original N64 game's criticism for so long. Specifically, the optional combat advice, environmental secrets she can help uncover, and new dialogue that allows her to react to what's happening without constantly interrupting gameplay are all notable changes worth mentioning, as they effectively make her the companion she was always meant to be, rather than the babysitter she actually was.

Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake May Be Hiding a Massive Endgame Surprise

Ocarina of Time Remake may be hiding one of its biggest surprises ahead of launch, just as Tears of the Kingdom did with the Depths.

By Josh Cotts

Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Is Promoting Navi From Babysitter to Companion

Beginning with changes to Navi's frequent interruptions (because that's largely what she has been most criticized for), several early previews of the Ocarina of Time remake have confirmed she actually interrupts much less frequently now. For example, in Chris Scullion's preview of the game for VGC, the author states, "[Navi] can be called upon during battles if you lock onto an enemy then press Right on the D-Pad, at which point she'll give advice on how to defeat them, but this is purely optional." Of course, "purely optional" is the key phrase worth paying attention to here, because in the original game, Link might encounter a new enemy, only for Navi to automatically interrupt said encounter with her infamous "Listen!" or "Watch out!"

The upcoming Ocarina of Time remake has made some massive changes to Navi, no doubt due to the criticism she has been receiving for nearly three decades...

Scullion then went on to say that when Navi does make unsolicited interruptions, it comes in the form of a speech bubble instead of a game-pausing event. The author compared it to "the way NPCs behave in recent Mario games like Super Mario Odyssey , where if you walk close to them a speech bubble will appear with dialogue, without you having to actively walk up to them and press a button." This was naturally corroborated by other hands-on previews of the Ocarina of Time remake, like Nintendo Life's, for example.

But Navi's improvements go beyond simply making her less annoying in the remake, as they also allow her to be more helpful. In Josephine Watson's Ocarina of Time remake preview for TechRadar, the author pointed out that "fairy messages" are scattered throughout Hyrule, which offer clues for advancing in a dungeon or uncovering secrets. So, rather than Navi constantly barking at you about what might be hidden in the area, your curiosity is essentially rewarded once you find one of those messages Watson described. It's a small taste of Zelda: Breath of the Wild 's approach to exploration and discovery put into the Ocarina of Time remake, and I, for one, find that to be a welcome improvement over the original game.

Navi's New Dialogue Gives Her Relationship With Link Room to Grow

I think what's most interesting about these changes, though, is how they could ultimately affect Navi's relationship with Link. In the original Ocarina of Time , Navi was technically Link's companion, but most of her interactions with him involved telling him where to go, what to do, or how to defeat an enemy. Granted, she was sent by the Great Deku Tree to help Link in the first place, so I can't exactly blame her for doing her job. Still, considering how much time the two spend together throughout the game, it's a shame their relationship never really gets much of a chance to grow beyond that.

Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake's Most Underrated Upgrade Is Navi's New Role
2026's Biggest GTA 6 Rival Isn't Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake
Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake May Be Hiding a Massive Endgame Surprise
Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Reveals Yet Another Pre-Order Bonus

With the remake's new approach to Navi, however, I think there's a good chance that could change. Having her react more seamlessly to what's happening around Link without constantly interrupting gameplay should make her feel more involved in the adventure, rather than someone who only speaks up when there's something Link needs to know. Even the new fairy messages play into that, as they give players a reason to actually seek out Navi's guidance rather than wait for her to force it on them. Again, I never really had a problem with Navi in the original Ocarina of Time , but I can still appreciate Nintendo giving her a chance to be more than a walking tutorial. If anything, these changes might finally help other players see her the way I always did.

The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
